page.title: Data Visualization Tools
page.subtitle: Professional research chart tools supporting multiple chart types for intuitive data presentation

upload.title: Data Upload
upload.dragHint: Drag and drop data files here or click to upload

heatmap.desc: Visualize gene expression matrices or correlation matrices

volcano.desc: Display statistical significance and fold change of differentially expressed genes

pca.desc: Show sample similarities and differences via dimensionality reduction

venn.desc: Show intersections and unions among multiple datasets

line.desc: Show data trends over time or conditions

bar.desc: Compare numerical values between different groups

pie.desc: Show proportional relationships of parts to the whole

boxplot.desc: Display data distribution with median, quartiles, and outliers

violin.desc: Show data distribution density and statistical features

bubble.desc: Show relationships in 3D data where size represents an additional dimension

radar.desc: Display comprehensive performance across multiple dimensions

sankey.desc: Show flow distribution and conversion between nodes

roc.desc: Evaluate classification model performance and cutoff selection

waterfall.desc: Show cumulative impact of changes on the total

manhattan.desc: Show chromosome positioning results from GWAS

qqplot.desc: Assess whether data distribution matches theoretical distribution

dendrogram.desc: Display tree structure of hierarchical clustering

area.desc: Show cumulative total changes over time

stackedBar.desc: Show contribution of parts to the total

sunburst.desc: Show hierarchical data as ring proportions

errorbar.desc: Display data mean and error range

goBubble.desc: Show GO enrichment terms, gene counts, and significance

keggPathway.desc: Show gene enrichment in KEGG pathways

gsea.desc: Show dynamic cumulative distribution of gene set enrichment

correlation.desc: Display correlation coefficient matrix among multiple variables

umap.desc: Show non-linear dimensionality reduction clustering of high-dimensional data

wgcna.desc: Show weighted gene co-expression network analysis results

cnv.desc: Show regions and extent of copy number variations

fusion.desc: Show structure and position of gene fusion events

oncoplot.desc: Display mutation spectrum matrix across multiple samples

alignment.desc: Show sequence alignment results and consistency

phylogenetic.desc: Show phylogenetic relationships of species or genes

splicing.desc: Show alternative splicing event patterns and frequencies

atacseq.desc: Show signal distribution of chromatin accessibility regions

methylation.desc: Show genomic distribution of DNA methylation levels
